summary: Comprehensive frontend-only E2E testing for Rang Mohor wedding gifts site. All 15 flows in the review request were exercised via Playwright on desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844). Every critical user journey — home hero, live search, product detail (qty/thumbs/add-to-cart/wishlist), cart with coupon MOHOR10, checkout with shipping/delivery/payment, orders list, auth login, profile+addresses, shop filters+sort+pagination, dark-mode persistence across reload, mobile drawer, contact form, and all secondary pages (about/faq/privacy/terms/categories/wishlist) — worked end to end without console errors.
action_items: Minor: review-request document listed testids 'shop-now-btn', 'cart-btn', 'wishlist-btn' but code uses 'hero-shop-now-btn', 'cart-icon-link', 'wishlist-icon-link'. Naming is consistent internally, so no change required — just update spec/documentation for future testers.
critical_code_review_comments: All interactive elements expose data-testid attributes; good for testability.
Auth is mocked (any email/password logs in) — acceptable per spec (frontend-only demo).
LocalStorage persistence for cart/wishlist/user/orders/darkMode confirmed working across reloads.
test_credentials: Mock auth — any email/password works. Used demo@rangmohor.com / pass1234.
seed_data_creation: None — used built-in sample products p01-p20.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Correct testids in code: hero-shop-now-btn, cart-icon-link, wishlist-icon-link (not shop-now-btn/cart-btn/wishlist-btn). Product IDs p01-p20. Coupon MOHOR10 verified (10% discount applied on ₹2,598 subtotal -> total ₹2,338). Ship-state field exists but wasn't in the original spec list; form validates all shipping fields. Dark mode persists via localStorage under html.dark class.
